description: VAPT Enforcer Pattern Library v2.0 — All 125 risks, all enforcer types. Keys are enforcer-named (htaccess, wp_config, php_functions, wordpress, wordpress_core, fail2ban, nginx, apache, caddy_native, cloudflare, iis, caddy). Every entry includes a driver{} sub-object with machine-executable fields consumed by vapt_driver_manifest_v2.0.json.

enforcer_key_map.wp_config: wp-config.php enforcer — enriched with target_constants, insertion anchor
enforcer_key_map.php_functions: PHP Functions enforcer — hook-based code for functions.php / plugin file
enforcer_key_map.wordpress_core: WordPress Core enforcer — core filter hooks
enforcer_key_map.cloudflare: Cloudflare edge implementation derived from .htaccess correction
enforcer_key_map.iis: IIS web.config implementation derived from .htaccess correction
enforcer_key_map.caddy: Caddyfile v2 implementation derived from .htaccess correction

RISK-001.title: wp-cron.php Enabled Leads to DoS Attack

wp_config.insertion_rule: Must be placed BEFORE: require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-settings.php';

RISK-002.title: Xmlrpc enabled Leads to Ping back attack

htaccess.wrapped_code:
# BEGIN VAPT RISK-002
<Files "xmlrpc.php">
    Order Deny,Allow
    Deny from all
</Files>
# END VAPT RISK-002
htaccess.rollback: Remove # BEGIN VAPT RISK-002 ... # END VAPT RISK-002 block from .htaccess

driver.write_block:
# BEGIN VAPT RISK-002
<Files "xmlrpc.php">
    Order Deny,Allow
    Deny from all
</Files>
# END VAPT RISK-002

cloudflare.name: VAPT RISK-002
cloudflare.dashboard_path: Cloudflare → Security → WAF → Custom Rules → Create Rule

iis.web_config_snippet:
<!-- BEGIN VAPT RISK-002 -->
<configuration>
  <system.webServer>
    <security><requestFiltering><hiddenSegments>
      <add segment="xmlrpc.php" />
    </hiddenSegments></requestFiltering></security>
  </system.webServer>
</configuration>
<!-- END VAPT RISK-002 -->

caddy.verification: caddy validate && curl -sI https://yoursite.com/blocked | grep HTTP

RISK-003.title: Username Enumeration via WordPress REST API

htaccess.code:
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !/wp-json/wp/v2/users/me [NC]
    RewriteRule ^wp-json/wp/v2/users - [F,L]
</IfModule>
htaccess.wrapped_code:
# BEGIN VAPT RISK-003
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !/wp-json/wp/v2/users/me [NC]
    RewriteRule ^wp-json/wp/v2/users - [F,L]
</IfModule>
# END VAPT RISK-003
htaccess.note: Must be BEFORE # BEGIN WordPress. WP [L] catch-all makes anything after # END WordPress a dead zone. Covers /users and /users/ variants.
htaccess.rollback: Remove # BEGIN VAPT RISK-003 ... # END VAPT RISK-003 block from .htaccess

driver.write_block:

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !/wp-json/wp/v2/users/me [NC]
    RewriteRule ^wp-json/wp/v2/users - [F,L]
</IfModule>
# END VAPT RISK-003

cloudflare.name: VAPT RISK-003
cloudflare.dashboard_path: Cloudflare → Security → WAF → Custom Rules → Create Rule

iis.web_config_snippet:
<!-- BEGIN VAPT RISK-003 -->
<configuration>
  <system.webServer>
    <rewrite><rules>
      <rule name="VAPT RISK-003" stopProcessing="true">
        <match url="^wp-json/wp/v2/users.*" />
        <action type="CustomResponse" statusCode="403" statusReason="Forbidden" statusDescription="Blocked by VAPT RISK-003" />
      </rule>
    </rules></rewrite>
  </system.webServer>
</configuration>
<!-- END VAPT RISK-003 -->

RISK-005.title: Exposed WordPress Admin Username via Author Query

htaccess.code:
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (^|&)author=\d+ [NC]
    RewriteRule ^ - [F,L]
</IfModule>
htaccess.wrapped_code:
# BEGIN VAPT RISK-005
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (^|&)author=\d+ [NC]
    RewriteRule ^ - [F,L]
</IfModule>
# END VAPT RISK-005
htaccess.note: Must be BEFORE # BEGIN WordPress. Regex (^|&)author=\d+ matches all numeric IDs and any query param position.
htaccess.rollback: Remove # BEGIN VAPT RISK-005 ... # END VAPT RISK-005 block from .htaccess

driver.write_block:
# BEGIN VAPT RISK-005
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (^|&)author=\d+ [NC]
    RewriteRule ^ - [F,L]
</IfModule>
# END VAPT RISK-005

cloudflare.name: VAPT RISK-005
cloudflare.dashboard_path: Cloudflare → Security → WAF → Custom Rules → Create Rule

iis.web_config_snippet:
<!-- BEGIN VAPT RISK-005 -->
<configuration>
  <system.webServer>
    <rewrite><rules>
      <rule name="VAPT RISK-005" stopProcessing="true">
          <conditions><add input="{QUERY_STRING}" pattern="author=\d+" /></conditions>
        <match url=".*" />
        <action type="CustomResponse" statusCode="403" statusReason="Forbidden" statusDescription="Blocked by VAPT RISK-005" />
      </rule>
    </rules></rewrite>
  </system.webServer>
</configuration>
<!-- END VAPT RISK-005 -->
